But the fix commit again introduced one frontmatter omission of the exact class this panel has now fixed twice: bead 2 step 7's G4 treatment adds `repair phase` to EnsurePhaseSemanticsV2's invocation sites ('repair reconciles ... BEFORE its guard evaluates' — the guard bead 1 places in cmd/mindspec/repair.go, and repair.go hosts no existing EnsureMigrated-style preflight to piggyback on, so a new call is added to that file), yet chunk 2's key_file_paths — which gained internal/approve/impl.go for this same step last round — omit cmd/mindspec/repair.go. release.go, the other new invocation site, is listed. I swept ALL TEN bead sections' named edit sites against their chunks this round: this is the only omission (chunks 1, 3-10 fully reconcile; bead 1's 'managed .gitignore block' entry is plausibly a code-constant change rather than a direct .gitignore edit, so not flagged). Second, smaller: the fence-tightening duty ('bead 2 TIGHTENS the same test to exactly-one when it wires the caller') is recorded only in bead 1's step 1 — bead 2's own step 3 names the fence as 'created + call-site-fenced in bead 1' without stating bead 2's tightening obligation, so a bead-2 implementer working from bead 2's section would wire the caller and leave the fence at zero-outside-allowlist, silently stranding the OQ-3 boundary's 'pinning exactly one caller' end-state. Both fixes are one line each.
